name: @tagpilot/ga4-mcp
description: Free, read-only Google Analytics 4 MCP server by Tag Pilot. Zero Google Cloud setup: sign in with Google in your browser, query GA4 from Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.test: rm -rf build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-test/test/
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run build

author: Tag Concierge sp. z o.o. (https://tagpilot.io)
